title: 1994 Corvette in the Night Studio in the Forest
label: MIDNIGHT GARAGE
description:
Step inside the Night Studio, where a torch red 1994 Chevrolet Corvette C4 rests in the warm, quiet room. Outside the wide windows, pale moonlight filters through the pine forest as mist drifts slowly between the trees. For two hours, you will hear only calm ambient electronic music filled with warm synth pads, a soft deep bass, and a gentle beat. It is a peaceful place to keep you company while you are working, studying, or relaxing.

No talking. No lyrics. No sudden sounds. Every track is original, made for CEO Focus.

CEO Focus | Dream Cars. Easy Listening.
